name: UpdateMsg
summary: Prefix-varint length (max 512) then that many raw bytes — fixed, not polymorphic.
purpose: Carrier blob for one component fragment payload; pairs with FragmentUpdateMsg identity.

lifecycle.if_absent: fallback to larger replicate paths or missing patches

fields.name: blob
fields.note: prefix-varint; reject if >= 0x201; then raw bytes, max 512. The length prefix is part of prefixed_bytes, so there is no separate length field.
fields.provenance: legacy (none); merged from the former length + blob pair (double-count repair)
